Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 17
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the sourced information and incorrectly stated that Raymond Cannon (director of Why Leave Home?) died in 1951. The WebSurfer’s results showed Cannon’s death as June 7, 1977 (Wikipedia/IMDb). This misinterpretation led to the wrong comparison and conclusion; in reality, James Kirkwood Sr. (d. 1963) died before Raymond Cannon (d. 1977), so A Dream or Two Ago has the director who died first.
